 Saman Shafiq USA TODAY Oct. 28, 2026, 8:02 a.m. ET Hear this story Bath & Body Works is getting into the Christmas countdown with a new Advent calendar packed with holiday fragrances, body care and accessories.
 The limited-edition collection, “Feel the Wonder,” includes 12 products, seven of which are exclusive to the calendar, Bath & Body Works told USA TODAY. The calendar costs $50 and has a reported value of more than $115.
 Signups for early access begin Nov. 4, ahead of the calendar’s Nov. 16 release in stores and online.
 “This year’s Advent calendar was inspired by the traditions and moments that make the holiday season memorable, from decorating the tree to gathering with family and friends,” Melissa Tauro, vice president of merchandising at Bath & Body Works, told USA TODAY.
 Tauro said the calendar was designed to mix familiar holiday favorites with products created specifically for the release.
 USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. More than half of its contents are exclusive, including seven products available only through the Advent calendar. The assortment will also include multiple full-size products.
 What is inside the Bath & Body Works Advent calendar?
 Bath & Body Works has not revealed every product inside the “Feel the Wonder Advent Calendar,” but the retailer says it contains 12 items spanning home fragrance, body care and accessories.
 Seven of the products are exclusive to the calendar.
 “Customers can expect a curated holiday experience that combines some of Bath & Body Works’ most-loved seasonal fragrances with exclusive products designed to surprise and delight,” Tauro said.
 The calendar is valued at more than $115, but will sell for $50.
 How to get the Bath & Body Works Advent calendar
 Signups for “Feel the Wonder" open on Wednesday, Nov. 4, at 6 a.m. ET through Drops , Bath & Body Works’ platform for exclusive releases and early-access opportunities.
 The calendar will be available beginning Nov. 16 in stores and online for a limited time, while supplies last.

 The Advent calendar is part of Bath & Body Works’ broader holiday rollout, dubbed “Season of Wonder.” The campaign features “New Girl” actor Zooey Deschanel as its “Holiday Wonder Maker.”
 The company says the campaign centers on fragrances and products inspired by holiday traditions .
 “The holidays are a magical time, bringing people together through cherished traditions and moments of joy,” Veronique Gabai-Pinsky, Bath & Body Works chief brand and product officer, said in a statement. “With Season of Wonder, we’re celebrating everything that makes this time of year special through fragrances that evoke memories, thoughtful gifts that create connections and new experiences that inspire discovery.”
 The holiday assortment combines new and returning fragrances across home and body care products.
 Collection highlights include:
 Vanilla Cocoa Flurries: A new fragrance featuring notes of white cocoa, chilled coconut milk and vanilla woods, available across body care, home fragrance and hand soaps. 
 Snowflakes & Cashmere: The returning fragrance, with notes of vanilla cashmere cream, caramel woods and frosted clementine, will be available as an eau de parfum for the first time. It will also be sold as hand soaps, home fragrance and laundry products. 
 Bubble Baths: A new addition to the holiday assortment.
 Returning home fragrances: Pure Wonder, Moonlit Goddess, Fresh Balsam, Lavender & Pine and Winter.
 "Season of Wonder" is available inside Bath & Body Works stores and online at bathandbodyworks.com across the United States and Canada. Select products are available at Ulta and Amazon.
